overview: BizBook India is a premium, mobile-first billing and accounting app for small and medium businesses in India. It features invoice creation with auto-calculated GST, inventory management, customer and supplier management, expense tracking with receipt photos, purchase order tracking, detailed P&L and GST reports, email invoice delivery, and a full admin panel with user management.
features: Invoice creation with GST auto-calculation (CGST+SGST at 18%)
Inventory management with stock status badges
Customer and supplier CRUD with ledgers
Expense tracker with receipt photo uploads
P&L report calculated fresh on every page load
GSTR-1 tax report with CSV/PDF export
Settings with 4 themes: light, dark, sepia, high-contrast
Admin panel with user management and role labels
Mobile-first responsive design optimized for India SMBs
